geography.name: Texas
geography.boundary_limit: The 254 counties bound geographic selection only. They are not an asset-count denominator.

prohibited_inference: Do not create an asset, route, terminal, edge, voltage, owner, or geometry from imagery, proximity, street data, or a synthetic electrical case.
A line endpoint name is not an electrical terminal edge unless the source explicitly supplies an identified terminal-to-terminal relation.
ACTIVSg2000 remains synthetic and is never evidence of a real Texas asset or connection.
truth_policy.coverage_policy: A source record count is only a denominator for that source selection when the source explicitly defines that selection as complete. Otherwise denominator is null and the coverage state must remain partial, unknown, unavailable, or restricted.

source_records.license_or_terms: U.S. federal public data; retain the form year and source terms with a derived artifact.
source_records.geometry_basis: Reported plant coordinates in the Plant schedule; a point is a plant location, not an interconnection point or site boundary.
source_records.coverage_limit: National annual survey of plants/generators with combined nameplate capacity of 1 MW or greater; it does not inventory distribution, transmission, substations, physical load, or electrical connectivity.
source_records.recommended_use: Authoritative source for a versioned Texas generation/storage artifact once a downloader writes the exact checksum and row counts.

source_records.version: Form EIA-860, reporting year 2025 early release; HTTP Last-Modified 2026-06-09
source_records.license_or_terms: U.S. federal public data; source workbook says this early release is not fully edited, excludes some pending-validation records, and is inappropriate for aggregation.

audit_observation.count_limit: These are direct workbook row counts, not statewide completeness claims or a stable published aggregate.

source_records.geometry_basis: Reported plant coordinates; coordinate accuracy/precision are not quantified in the workbook and must be recorded as source-declared/unquantified.
source_records.coverage_limit: Early-release caveat prevents use as an authoritative Texas aggregate denominator.
source_records.recommended_use: Freshness probe only. Use final 2024 EIA-860 for a reproducible artifact until final 2025 is published.

source_records.authority: Federal User Community / HIFLD archive published through Esri ArcGIS Online
source_records.license_or_terms: Esri Master License Agreement shown in item metadata; preserve terms and source metadata before redistribution.

audit_observation.texas_envelope_limit: This is a service query against the Texas bounding envelope, which includes neighboring-state features. It is not a Texas count, a statewide denominator, or a completeness measure.

source_records.geometry_basis: Service geometry is native source geometry. Feature fields include SOURCE, SOURCEDATE, VAL_METHOD, VAL_DATE, and INFERRED, so a derived artifact must retain them and label each source/validation basis.
source_records.connectivity_limit: SUB_1 and SUB_2 are endpoint names, often UNKNOWN or TAP; no stable substation identifiers or source-backed terminal edge relation are supplied. Do not construct connectivity edges from these fields.
source_records.coverage_limit: The provider marks the layer archived and no longer updated/maintained. Its own samples include imagery/OpenStreetMap-derived and inferred records. It is a partial, stale public line overlay, never owner-level Texas completeness.
source_records.recommended_use: Acquire a Texas-polygon-selected snapshot with response metadata and per-feature validation fields; expose it as partial observed geometry only.

source_records.authority: USGS / HIFLD-derived Texas Wind Energy Infrastructure service metadata
source_records.version: Substations and transmission lines: 2017-08-08, as stated by source metadata
source_records.access: restricted_at_audit: FeatureServer returned ArcGIS token-required error 499
source_records.license_or_terms: Esri Master License Agreement shown in item metadata
geometry_fields: described by metadata but unavailable for unauthenticated retrieval
source_records.geometry_basis: Unavailable until an authorized retrieval records the actual layer schema and source metadata.
source_records.coverage_limit: Even if retrieved, source metadata gives 2017 currency and does not certify statewide current completeness or electrical topology.
source_records.recommended_use: Record the failed/restricted attempt. Do not use copied ArcGIS layers as a replacement, and do not claim substation coverage.

source_records.access: public filing instruction; individual filings require separate retrieval and terms review
source_records.license_or_terms: PUCT filing/public-record terms to be retained per selected filing
geometry_fields: utility-filed shapefile or geodatabase service-area boundary
source_records.geometry_basis: The PUCT memo says these are good-faith utility submissions and approximate rather than official paper-map digitizations.
source_records.coverage_limit: Service areas can support an owner/acquisition outreach ledger. They do not contain lines, substations, distribution devices, customers, terminal connectivity, or asset counts.
source_records.recommended_use: Use after filing-specific acquisition to enumerate owner coverage attempts; never render it as grid assets or use it to assign a line/device owner without source evidence.

coverage_rows.scope: Texas, EIA Form 860 final annual survey selection
coverage_rows.reason: The authoritative source is available but this ledger deliberately owns no generation artifact; generation_inventory owns exact source acquisition and normalization.
Archived HIFLD geometry is retrievable, but the service does not declare owner-level Texas completeness. The 10,239 Texas-envelope observation is not a state denominator.
The identified Texas source endpoint requires a token at audit time and is 2017 vintage. No public current statewide authoritative substation acquisition was verified.
No public, statewide, authoritative, machine-readable distribution geometry/device source was verified. Utility service-area boundaries do not fill this gap.

No audited source supplies identified terminals and edge relations. HIFLD endpoint names and synthetic ACTIVSg2000 topology are expressly insufficient; accepted_source_backed_edge_count is 0 for this audit, which is not a physical-asset count.
